title: card-loop triage result v2
description: Stage `triage` (design D4/D5): classify one oracle divergence between our engine and DCGO. `ours_wrong` -> fix gate (no second opinion; the gate arbitrates). `dcgo_quirk` / `unreachable` are TERMINATING calls: both families must independently agree and each must cite a source, else the item escalates. `scenario_wrong` sends the exam back to its author with the objection (the line or its expect_ruling misreads the card or ruling: wrong pick, wrong step, a non-discriminating observable). `undetermined` escalates. `citation`: general_rule.pdf section (`rule`, e.g. `16-36`; the PDF outranks DCGO for rules), official ruling (`ruling`, `qa:<Q-number>`), or DCGO C# (`dcgo`, `<path>.cs:<line>`); null only when no source supports the call (which escalates a terminating call). `reasoning`: the argument, including for `unreachable` the measured reason no legal line reaches the clause. Strict-mode compatible.
